question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A small group of people who spend their time together and do not welcome other people into that group
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"clique"** means a small group of people who spend their time together and do not welcome other people into that group. (गुट)

 
 
• **Example: **The school was divided into several **cliques,** each with its own interests and activities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Squad** (दस्ता): A small group of people having a particular task.

 
 
• **Example:** The rescue squad arrived promptly at the scene of the accident.
 
 
 
• **Employees** (कर्मचारी): People who work for someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The company has over 200 employees working in various departments.
 
 
 
• **Lobby** (लॉबी): A group of people seeking to influence politicians or public officials on a particular issue.
 
 
• **Example:** The environmental lobby is pushing for new legislation to protect wildlife.
